purpose: Context KB for pacs.009 FinancialInstitutionCreditTransfer validation. For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and all possible fixes. Based on CBPR+ SR2025 Usage Guideline (pacs.009.001.08) and SWIFT MX Enterprise KB.
reference_documents: SWIFT MX Enterprise LLM KB v2.0

iso_20022_rules.RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl: If CopyDuplicate is present, Related MUST be present.
iso_20022_rules.InstructedAgentRule: If GrpHdr/InstdAgt is present, then CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.InstructingAgentRule: If GrpHdr/InstgAgt is present, then CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.TotalInterbankSettlementAmountRule: If GrpHdr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt is present, all CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt must use the same currency.
iso_20022_rules.TotalInterbankSettlementAmountAndSumRule: If GrpHdr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt is present, it must equal the sum of all CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt.
iso_20022_rules.GroupHeaderInterbankSettlementDateRule: If GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is present, CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.TransactionInterbankSettlementDateRule: If GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is not present, CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt MUST be present.
iso_20022_rules.PaymentTypeInformationRule: If GrpHdr/PmtTpInf is present, CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.NumberOfTransactionsAndCreditTransfersRu: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the number of CdtTrfTxInf occurrences.
iso_20022_rules.AmountPositiveRule: IntrBkSttlmAmt must be >= 0 (minInclusive=0), max 5 fractional digits, max 18 total digits. ActiveCurrencyAndAmount from XSD pacs.009.001.12.
iso_20022_rules.BICFIFormatRule: All BICFI values must match pattern [A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?. In pacs.009, Dbtr and Cdtr are BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification8 (FI type) — their identification is via FinInstnId/BICFI, NOT via PartyIdentification or customer fields.
iso_20022_rules.LEIFormatRule: LEI fields must match pattern [A-Z0-9]{18}[0-9]{2} (exactly 20 chars). Used in BranchData5/LEI and FinancialInstitutionIdentification23/LEI.
iso_20022_rules.ChrgBrCBPRRequiredRule: ChrgBr is NOT in the base ISO 20022 XSD for pacs.009 (CreditTransferTransaction67 and CreditTransferTransaction69 have no ChargeBearerType element). ChrgBr in pacs.009 is a CBPR+ guideline requirement added via usage rules, not via schema. When present, it must be SLEV. Value DEBT/CRED/SHAR are not used for FI-to-FI payments.
iso_20022_rules.UndrlygFICdtTrfRule: pacs.009.001.12 introduces a new optional element UndrlygFICdtTrf (CreditTransferTransaction69) alongside the existing UndrlygCstmrCdtTrf. This represents an underlying FI credit transfer (e.g., bank-to-bank cover for another FI transfer). When UndrlygFICdtTrf is present, PmtId, IntrBkSttlmAmt, Dbtr, and Cdtr are mandatory inside it.
iso_20022_rules.XpryDtTmFormatRule: pacs.009.001.12 GrpHdr has optional XpryDtTm (expiry datetime). When present, must use CBPR+ offset datetime format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. No Z, no milliseconds.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr/Priority must equal CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty when both are present.
AppHdr/Fr BIC must match InstgAgt BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match InstdAgt BIC, except when CpyDplct = COPY or CODU.
AppHdr/Fr BIC must match InstgAgt BIC and AppHdr/To BIC must match InstdAgt BIC when CpyDplct is absent.
If BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, then Nm and PstlAdr are NOT allowed in the same FinInstnId block.
If Nm is present in FinInstnId, PstlAdr must also be present, and vice versa.
All proprietary/text fields (excl. Nm/Adr/RmtInf) limited to FIN-X charset. Nm/Adr/RmtInf extended with !#$&%*=^_{|}~";<>@[\] (< as <, > as >).
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.03' (SR2025). This element is mandatory (min occurrence changed to 1).
DateTime fields must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format. Z suffix is forbidden. Milliseconds are forbidden.
CBPR+ allows single transactions only per message.
BranchIdentification is removed from InstgAgt, InstdAgt, DbtrAgt, CdtrAgt, IntrmyAgt1/2/3, PrvsInstgAgt1/2/3 and settlement agents.

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ messages.

errors.description: AppHdr element is absent; CBPR+ mandates BusinessApplicationHeaderV02.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block before the <Document> element.
Ensure AppHdr contains Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc, CreDt, and optionally Prty.

tags.description: Sending MessagingEndpoint. Must contain BIC8 or BIC11 when exchanged on SWIFT.

errors.description: Fr element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{InstgAgt_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI value from CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr BICFI does not match CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt BICFI (when CpyDplct is absent or not COPY/CODU).
possible_fixes: Read InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI from the transaction block and set AppHdr/Fr/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI to the same value.
Alternatively update InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI to match AppHdr/Fr if Fr is the authoritative source.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters following ISO 9362.
Example valid BIC: DEUTDEFFXXX

tags.description: Receiving MessagingEndpoint. Must contain BIC8 or BIC11 on SWIFT.

errors.description: To element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{InstdAgt_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI.

errors.description: AppHdr/To BICFI does not match CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt BICFI.
possible_fixes: Read InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI from the transaction block and set AppHdr/To/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI to match.
Alternatively update InstdAgt/BICFI to match AppHdr/To if To is authoritative.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the Business Message. Must equal GrpHdr/MsgId.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Copy the value of GrpHdr/MsgId and insert as <BizMsgIdr>{MsgId_value}</BizMsgIdr>.
If MsgId is also absent, generate a unique Max35Text value (e.g. MSG-YYYYMMDD-001).

errors.description: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr does not equal Document/GrpHdr/MsgId.
possible_fixes: Read GrpHdr/MsgId and set BizMsgIdr to the same value.
If BizMsgIdr is the source of truth, update GrpHdr/MsgId to match BizMsgIdr.
Never invent a new value — always harvest from the other field.

errors.description: BizMsgIdr exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate the value to a maximum of 35 characters.
Ensure the truncated value remains meaningful and unique.
Synchronize the truncated value back to GrpHdr/MsgId.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must exactly match the Document namespace.

errors.description: MsgDefIdr is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgDefIdr>pacs.009.001.08</MsgDefIdr> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
possible_fixes: Read the xmlns attribute from the Document root element (e.g. urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pacs.009.001.08).
Extract the message identifier portion and set MsgDefIdr to 'pacs.009.001.08'.
Ensure no trailing spaces or version mismatches.

tags.note: Minimum occurrence changed to 1 by CBPR+ SR2025 guideline.
tags.description: Business Service identifier. Mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025; must be 'swift.cbprplus.03'.

errors.description: BizSvc is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.03</BizSvc> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: BizSvc contains an incorrect value (e.g. 'swift.cbprplus.02' from older release).
possible_fixes: Replace value with 'swift.cbprplus.03' as mandated by SR2025.
Note: SR2024 and earlier used 'swift.cbprplus.02'; upgrade to .03 for SR2025.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the Business Message. Must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format; Z and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDt>{current datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 format}</CreDt> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under CBPR+.
AppHdr/CreDt contains milliseconds which are forbidden under CBPR+.
AppHdr/CreDt is in the past beyond tolerance window.
possible_fixes: Replace with the current datetime in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00 format.

tags.description: Priority of the Business Message. If present, must match CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty.

errors.description: AppHdr/Prty contains a value not in the allowed code list.
possible_fixes: Replace with 'NORM' (normal) or 'HIGH' (high priority).
Default to 'NORM' if priority is not specifically determined.

errors.description: AppHdr/Prty does not match CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty.
possible_fixes: Set AppHdr/Prty to the same value as CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty.
Alternatively set CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf/InstrPrty to match AppHdr/Prty.

tags.description: Unique message identifier. Must equal AppHdr/BizMsgIdr. No spaces.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <MsgId>{unique identifier up to 35 chars}</MsgId> as first child of GrpHdr.
Use format MSG-YYYYMMDD-NNN (e.g. MSG-20260528-001).
Ensure the same value is in AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 35 characters preserving meaningful prefix.
Synchronize truncated value to AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

errors.description: GrpHdr/MsgId already exists in the receiving system (duplicate message).
possible_fixes: Generate a new unique MsgId by appending current date and incrementing counter (e.g. MSG-20260528-002).
Check sending system for duplicate submission logic.

errors.description: MsgId contains characters outside the FIN-X character set or contains spaces.
possible_fixes: Remove spaces from MsgId.
Replace special/accented characters with ASCII equivalents.
Allowed: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + (no leading or trailing spaces).

tags.description: Creation date and time. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. Z suffix and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

errors.description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDtTm>.

errors.description: CreDtTm uses 'Z' suffix; forbidden under CBPR+.
CreDtTm contains milliseconds; forbidden under CBPR+.
CreDtTm is too far in the past.
possible_fixes: Replace with current datetime: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00.

tags.description: Number of transactions. Must equal actual count of CdtTrfTxInf blocks. CBPR+ allows single transactions only (value = 1).

errors.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs is absent.
possible_fixes: Count the actual number of CdtTrfTxInf blocks and insert <NbOfTxs>{count}</NbOfTxs>.
For CBPR+ single-transaction messages, value should be '1'.

errors.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs does not equal the actual number of CdtTrfTxInf blocks. Error code X00062.
possible_fixes: Count all CdtTrfTxInf elements in the message and set NbOfTxs to that count.
For CBPR+, ensure only one CdtTrfTxInf block exists and NbOfTxs = 1.

errors.description: CBPR+ requires single transactions only; multiple CdtTrfTxInf blocks found.
possible_fixes: Split the message into separate pacs.009 messages, one per transaction.
Remove extra CdtTrfTxInf blocks if they are duplicates.

errors.description: NbOfTxs contains non-numeric characters.
possible_fixes: Replace with a numeric integer string (max 15 digits). Example: '1'.

tags.description: Control sum. If present, must equal the sum of all CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt values.

errors.description: CtrlSum does not equal the sum of all IntrBkSttlmAmt values.
possible_fixes: Sum all IntrBkSttlmAmt values and set CtrlSum to the result.
If only one transaction (CBPR+), CtrlSum should equal the single IntrBkSttlmAmt.
Remove CtrlSum if not required to avoid mismatch errors.

errors.description: CtrlSum contains non-numeric or invalid decimal value.
possible_fixes: Use a valid decimal number format (e.g. 1000.00).
Maximum 18 digits total with up to 5 fraction digits.

tags.description: Settlement method. INGA = settled on books of instructed agent (CBPR+ preferred).

errors.description: SttlmMtd is absent from SttlmInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <SttlmMtd>INGA</SttlmMtd> as first child of SttlmInf.

errors.description: SttlmMtd contains a value not in the allowed codelist.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: INDA, INGA, COVE, CLRG.
Use INGA for standard CBPR+ interbank settlement.

tags.description: GrpHdr-level instructing agent. If present, CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt must be absent (R5).

errors.description: Both GrpHdr/InstgAgt and CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt are present; this violates R5.
possible_fixes: Remove GrpHdr/InstgAgt if agent is already specified at transaction level.
Remove CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt if agent is specified at group level.

tags.description: GrpHdr-level instructed agent. If present, CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt must be absent (R4).

errors.description: Both GrpHdr/InstdAgt and CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt are present; this violates R4.
possible_fixes: Remove GrpHdr/InstdAgt if agent is specified at transaction level.
Remove CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt if agent is specified at group level.

tags.description: Payment identification block. Contains InstrId, EndToEndId, TxId, and UETR (mandatory under CBPR+).

errors.description: PmtId block is absent from CdtTrfTxInf.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <PmtId> block containing InstrId, EndToEndId, TxId, and UETR.

tags.description: End-to-end identification assigned by the initiating party. Must be passed through the chain unchanged. 'NOTPROVIDED' is allowed.

errors.description: EndToEndId is absent from PmtId.
possible_fixes: Insert <EndToEndId>NOTPROVIDED</EndToEndId> if the value is unknown.
Otherwise insert <EndToEndId>{originator's end-to-end reference, max 35 chars}</EndToEndId>.

errors.description: EndToEndId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters maximum.
Use 'NOTPROVIDED' if the original reference cannot be preserved within length limit.

tags.description: Transaction identification assigned by the instructing agent. Unique reference for the transaction.

errors.description: TxId is absent from PmtId.
possible_fixes: Insert <TxId>{unique transaction reference, max 35 chars}</TxId>.
Example: TXN-20260528-001

errors.description: TxId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 35 characters maximum preserving the unique prefix.

tags.description: Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference. UUID v4 format. Mandatory under CBPR+ for pacs.009.

errors.description: UETR is absent from PmtId; mandatory under CBPR+.
possible_fixes: Insert <UETR>{valid UUID v4}</UETR> after TxId in PmtId.
Example valid UETR: 4a1a0945-5772-409a-83ba-240e666e0267
Generate a new UUID v4: lowercase hex, format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx where y in {8,9,a,b}.

errors.description: UETR is not a valid UUID v4 (wrong format, uppercase, wrong version digit, invalid variant).
possible_fixes: Ensure UETR is lowercase hex in format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.
The 13th character (version) must be '4'.
The 17th character (variant) must be 8, 9, a, or b.
Total length must be exactly 36 characters including hyphens.
Replace with a freshly generated UUID v4 if existing value is corrupt.

errors.description: UETR contains uppercase hexadecimal characters; must be lowercase.
possible_fixes: Convert all hex characters in UETR to lowercase.

tags.description: Interbank settlement amount with currency attribute (Ccy). Amount > 0. ISO 4217 currency code.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmAmt element is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <IntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy="{ISO4217_currency}">{amount}</IntrBkSttlmAmt>.
Ensure Ccy attribute is a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmAmt is present but the Ccy attribute is missing.
possible_fixes: Add Ccy attribute with a valid ISO 4217 3-letter currency code.
Example: <IntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy="USD">{amount}</IntrBkSttlmAmt>

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmAmt Ccy attribute is not a valid ISO 4217 currency code.
possible_fixes: Replace Ccy attribute with a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).
Currency codes are always 3 uppercase letters.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmAmt amount is zero or negative.
possible_fixes: Replace with a positive decimal amount greater than zero.
Maximum: 18 digits total, 5 fraction digits.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmAmt currency differs from GrpHdr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt currency.
possible_fixes: Ensure all IntrBkSttlmAmt currencies match the TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt currency.
Remove TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt from GrpHdr if currency alignment is not possible.

tags.note: Mandatory at transaction level when GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is absent (R9). Cannot coexist with GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt (R8).
tags.description: Interbank settlement date. ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or a future business day.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmDt is absent from CdtTrfTxInf and GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is also absent; violates R9.
possible_fixes: Insert <IntrBkSttlmDt>{today's date as YYYY-MM-DD}</IntrBkSttlmDt> in CdtTrfTxInf.
Alternatively insert IntrBkSttlmDt at GrpHdr level; if so, remove it from CdtTrfTxInf.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmDt is in the past.
possible_fixes: Replace with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the next valid business day.
Do NOT use 'Z', time components, or offsets — date only.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmDt is present at both GrpHdr and CdtTrfTxInf level; violates R8.
possible_fixes: Remove CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt if GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt is the intended location.
Remove GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt if CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmDt is the intended location.

errors.description: IntrBkSttlmDt is not in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. includes time, Z suffix, or slashes).
possible_fixes: Use date-only format YYYY-MM-DD with no time component.

tags.description: Charge bearer. Specifies who bears the charges. SLEV = follow service level (CBPR+ default).

errors.description: ChrgBr is absent from CdtTrfTxInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <ChrgBr>SHAR</ChrgBr> in CdtTrfTxInf.
Position ChrgBr after XchgRate/InstdAmt and before ChrgsInf per XSD element order.

errors.description: ChrgBr contains an invalid code.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of: SHAR, CRED, DEBT.
Default value is SHAR (SLEV disallowed by policy).

errors.description: ChrgBr = CRED but ChrgsInf block is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert a ChrgsInf block with Amt and Agt elements when ChrgBr = CRED.
Alternatively change ChrgBr to SHAR to avoid the requirement.

tags.description: Instructed amount. Required when XchgRate is present. Currency may differ from IntrBkSttlmAmt.

errors.description: XchgRate is present but InstdAmt is absent; or InstdAmt currency differs from IntrBkSttlmAmt currency but XchgRate is missing.
possible_fixes: When InstdAmt.Ccy != IntrBkSttlmAmt.Ccy, insert <XchgRate>{rate}</XchgRate> in CdtTrfTxInf.
When currencies are the same, remove XchgRate entirely.

errors.description: InstdAmt is zero or negative.
possible_fixes: Set InstdAmt to a positive decimal amount greater than zero.

tags.description: Exchange rate. Required when InstdAmt currency != IntrBkSttlmAmt currency. Forbidden when currencies are the same.

errors.description: InstdAmt currency differs from IntrBkSttlmAmt currency but XchgRate is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <XchgRate>1.0</XchgRate> inside CdtTrfTxInf after InstdAmt.
Provide the actual exchange rate if known.

errors.description: InstdAmt currency equals IntrBkSttlmAmt currency but XchgRate is present.
possible_fixes: Remove the XchgRate element entirely when currencies are the same.

errors.description: XchgRate value is zero or negative.
possible_fixes: Replace with a positive decimal exchange rate greater than zero.

tags.note: Mandatory at transaction level when absent at GrpHdr level. BICFI mandatory on SWIFT.
tags.description: Instructing agent. Must have valid BICFI. Must match AppHdr/Fr.

errors.description: InstgAgt is absent from CdtTrfTxInf (and not present in GrpHdr).
possible_fixes: Insert <InstgAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{instructing_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></InstgAgt> in CdtTrfTxInf.
Use the same BIC as AppHdr/Fr.

errors.description: InstgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

errors.description: CBPR+: BICFI is present but Nm and/or PstlAdr are also present in the same FinInstnId.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from FinInstnId when BICFI is present.
BICFI takes precedence; Nm/PstlAdr are not allowed alongside BICFI under CBPR+.

errors.description: FinInstnId inside InstgAgt is present but completely empty.
possible_fixes: Add a BICFI child element to FinInstnId.
If no BICFI is available, provide Nm and PstlAdr (not both).

errors.description: BrnchId is present in InstgAgt; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from InstgAgt entirely.

tags.note: Mandatory at transaction level when absent at GrpHdr level.
tags.description: Instructed agent. Must have valid BICFI. Must match AppHdr/To.

errors.description: InstdAgt is absent from CdtTrfTxInf (and not present in GrpHdr).
possible_fixes: Insert <InstdAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{instructed_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></InstdAgt> in CdtTrfTxInf.
Use the same BIC as AppHdr/To.

errors.description: InstdAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

errors.description: CBPR+: BICFI is present but Nm and/or PstlAdr are also in the same FinInstnId.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from InstdAgt/FinInstnId when BICFI is present.

errors.description: BrnchId is present in InstdAgt; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from InstdAgt entirely.

tags.description: Debtor agent (previous instructing agent in chain). Must have valid BICFI under CBPR+. BrnchId removed. Maps from pacs.008 DbtrAgt; optional in pacs.009 when Dbtr (FinInstnId) is the direct ordering institution.

errors.description: DbtrAgt is absent from CdtTrfTxInf when required by message flow.
possible_fixes: Insert <DbtrAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{debtor_agent_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></DbtrAgt>.

errors.description: DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid 8 or 11 character BIC.
DBTRAGT_NEQ_CDTRAGT: DbtrAgt BIC must differ from CdtrAgt BIC.

errors.description: DbtrAgt BICFI equals CdtrAgt BICFI — loopback payment warning.
possible_fixes: Verify that the debtor agent and creditor agent are not the same institution.
Use different BICs for DbtrAgt and CdtrAgt.

errors.description: CBPR+: Nm and/or PstlAdr present alongside BICFI in DbtrAgt/FinInstnId.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from DbtrAgt/FinInstnId when BICFI is present.

errors.description: BrnchId present in DbtrAgt; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from DbtrAgt entirely.

tags.description: Creditor agent (next agent toward creditor). BICFI mandatory on SWIFT when present. Nm/PstlAdr optional when BICFI absent. BrnchId removed.

errors.description: CdtrAgt is absent from CdtTrfTxInf when required by message flow.
possible_fixes: Insert <CdtrAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{creditor_agent_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></CdtrAgt>.

errors.description: CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid 8 or 11 character BICFI.

errors.description: CdtrAgt/FinInstnId has Nm but PstlAdr is absent; Nm and PstlAdr must always be present together.
possible_fixes: Add <PstlAdr><AdrLine>{address}</AdrLine><Ctry>{ISO2_country}</Ctry></PstlAdr> to FinInstnId.
Or use BICFI instead of Nm/PstlAdr.

errors.description: CdtrAgt/FinInstnId has PstlAdr but Nm is absent.
possible_fixes: Add <Nm>{institution name, max 140 chars}</Nm> to FinInstnId.
Or remove PstlAdr and use BICFI instead.

errors.description: BrnchId present in CdtrAgt; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from CdtrAgt entirely.

tags.description: Ordering financial institution (debtor). In pacs.009, Dbtr is a BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification; must contain FinInstnId with BICFI or Nm/PstlAdr. Maps from pacs.008 Dbtr (PartyIdentification); party-level fields (Nm as individual, Id/PrvtId) are not applicable.

errors.description: Dbtr block is absent from CdtTrfTxInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <Dbtr><FinInstnId><BICFI>{ordering_institution_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Dbtr>.
If BICFI unavailable, use <Dbtr><FinInstnId><Nm>{institution_name}</Nm><PstlAdr><AdrLine>{addr}</AdrLine><Ctry>{CC}</Ctry></PstlAdr></FinInstnId></Dbtr>.

errors.description: Dbtr/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

errors.description: Dbtr/FinInstnId/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to 140 characters maximum.

errors.description: Dbtr/FinInstnId/Nm contains invalid characters.
possible_fixes: Nm/Adr fields support extended charset: A-Z a-z 0-9 / - ? : ( ) . , ' + SPACE and !#$&%*=^_{|}~";<>@[\].
Replace < with < and > with >.

errors.description: Dbtr/FinInstnId/PstlAdr is present but Ctry is missing.
possible_fixes: Add <Ctry>{ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code}</Ctry> inside PstlAdr.
Example: <Ctry>GB</Ctry>

errors.description: Dbtr/FinInstnId/PstlAdr uses structured form (no AdrLine) but TwnNm is absent.
possible_fixes: Add <TwnNm>{city name}</TwnNm> inside PstlAdr.
Or use AdrLine for unstructured address.

errors.description: Dbtr/FinInstnId/BICFI is present but Nm and/or PstlAdr are also present; BICFI is exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from Dbtr/FinInstnId when BICFI is present.
Or remove BICFI and retain Nm/PstlAdr.

tags.description: Account of the ordering financial institution (debtor). In pacs.009, identified by Othr or IBAN when applicable. Optional element.

errors.description: DbtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails ISO 13616 format or MOD97 checksum validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN: 2-letter country code + 2 check digits + BBAN (max 34 chars total).
Verify MOD97 check digit computation.

errors.description: Both IBAN and Othr are present in DbtrAcct/Id; mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Othr if IBAN is the correct identifier.
Remove IBAN if Othr is the correct identifier.

tags.description: Beneficiary financial institution (creditor). In pacs.009, Cdtr is a BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification; must contain FinInstnId with BICFI or Nm/PstlAdr. Maps from pacs.008 Cdtr (PartyIdentification); party-level fields are not applicable.

errors.description: Cdtr block is absent from CdtTrfTxInf.
possible_fixes: Insert <Cdtr><FinInstnId><BICFI>{beneficiary_institution_bic}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Cdtr>.
If BICFI unavailable, use <Cdtr><FinInstnId><Nm>{institution_name}</Nm><PstlAdr><AdrLine>{addr}</AdrLine><Ctry>{CC}</Ctry></PstlAdr></FinInstnId></Cdtr>.

errors.description: Cdtr/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid or malformed.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

errors.description: Cdtr/FinInstnId/Nm exceeds 140 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate to maximum 140 characters.

errors.description: Cdtr/FinInstnId/PstlAdr is present but Ctry is missing.
possible_fixes: Add <Ctry>{ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code}</Ctry> inside Cdtr/FinInstnId/PstlAdr.

errors.description: Cdtr institution name, country, or BIC matches a sanctioned entity.
possible_fixes: Replace sanctioned country code or institution identifier with non-sanctioned values for testing.
For production: escalate to compliance team; do not process.

tags.description: Account of the beneficiary financial institution (creditor). IBAN or Othr. Currency must match IntrBkSttlmAmt if present. Optional in pacs.009.

errors.description: CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails format or MOD97 checksum validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid IBAN (ISO 13616, max 34 chars, MOD97 check digits valid).
Example: GB29NWBK60161331926819

errors.description: CdtrAcct/Ccy does not match IntrBkSttlmAmt currency.
possible_fixes: Remove the Ccy attribute from CdtrAcct if it conflicts.
Or align CdtrAcct/Ccy with IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy.

tags.description: Payment type information. If present at GrpHdr, must NOT be present at CdtTrfTxInf level (R10).

errors.description: PmtTpInf is present at both GrpHdr and CdtTrfTxInf level; violates R10.
possible_fixes: Remove CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf if GrpHdr/PmtTpInf is present.
Remove GrpHdr/PmtTpInf if CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf is the intended location.

errors.description: PmtTpInf/InstrPrty contains a value not in the allowed codelist.
possible_fixes: Replace with NORM or HIGH.
Default: NORM.

errors.description: PmtTpInf/InstrPrty does not match AppHdr/Prty.
possible_fixes: Set InstrPrty to the same value as AppHdr/Prty.
Alternatively, set AppHdr/Prty to match InstrPrty.

tags.description: Remittance information. Ustrd and Strd are mutually exclusive within the same RmtInf block.

errors.description: Both Ustrd and Strd are present in the same RmtInf block; they are mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Strd if unstructured remittance is preferred.
Remove Ustrd if structured remittance is preferred.

errors.description: Ustrd text exceeds 140 characters per occurrence.
possible_fixes: Truncate each Ustrd occurrence to maximum 140 characters.
Maximum 4 Ustrd occurrences allowed.

errors.description: Strd/CdtrRefInf/Ref exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate Ref to maximum 35 characters.

errors.description: RmtInf contains characters outside the extended charset.
possible_fixes: RmtInf supports extended charset including !#$&%*=^_{|}~";<>@[\].
Replace < with < and > with >.
Remove unsupported characters.

tags.description: Purpose of the credit transfer. Cd (ISO 20022 code) and Prtry are mutually exclusive.

errors.description: Purp/Cd is not in the ISO 20022 external Purpose code list.
possible_fixes: Use a valid ISO 20022 Purpose code: e.g. GDDS (goods), SUPP (supplier), SALA (salary), TAXS (tax), TREA (treasury).
Alternatively use Purp/Prtry with a proprietary code (max 35 chars).

errors.description: Both Purp/Cd and Purp/Prtry are present; mutually exclusive.
possible_fixes: Remove Prtry if Cd is the correct choice.
Remove Cd if Prtry is the correct choice.

tags.description: First intermediary agent. BrnchId removed. IntrmyAgt2 cannot exist without IntrmyAgt1.

errors.description: IntrmyAgt2 is present but IntrmyAgt1 is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert IntrmyAgt1 before IntrmyAgt2.
Or remove IntrmyAgt2 if only one intermediary is needed.

errors.description: IntrmyAgt1/FinInstnId/BICFI is invalid.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid 8 or 11 character BIC.

errors.description: BrnchId present in IntrmyAgt1; removed under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Remove the BrnchId element from IntrmyAgt1 entirely.

errors.description: IntrmyAgt3 is present but IntrmyAgt2 is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert IntrmyAgt2 before IntrmyAgt3.
Or remove IntrmyAgt3 if only two intermediaries are needed.

tags.description: Charges information. Required when ChrgBr = CRED. Must contain Agt when present.

errors.description: ChrgBr = CRED but ChrgsInf is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert <ChrgsInf><Amt Ccy="{CCY}">{amount}</Amt><Agt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{BIC}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Agt></ChrgsInf>.

errors.description: ChrgsInf is present but the Agt element is absent.
possible_fixes: Add <Agt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{agent_BIC}</BICFI></FinInstnId></Agt> inside ChrgsInf.

errors.description: ChrgsInf/Amt currency does not match IntrBkSttlmAmt currency.
possible_fixes: Update ChrgsInf/Amt/@Ccy to match IntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy.

tags.description: Credit transfer transaction information block. CBPR+ permits exactly one CdtTrfTxInf per pacs.009 CORE message.

errors.description: CdtTrfTxInf block is absent.
possible_fixes: Insert a CdtTrfTxInf block carrying PmtId, IntrBkSttlmAmt, IntrBkSttlmDt and the agent chain.

errors.description: More than one CdtTrfTxInf present; CBPR+ allows a single transaction per message.
possible_fixes: Split additional transactions into separate messages so each carries exactly one CdtTrfTxInf.

tags.description: Point-to-point instruction identification. Max 35 chars.

errors.description: InstrId exceeds 35 characters.
possible_fixes: Truncate InstrId to a maximum of 35 characters.

tags.description: Second intermediary agent. Only valid when IntrmyAgt1 is present.

errors.description: IntrmyAgt2 present without IntrmyAgt1.
possible_fixes: Insert IntrmyAgt1 before IntrmyAgt2, or remove IntrmyAgt2.

errors.description: IntrmyAgt2 BICFI is invalid.
possible_fixes: Set FinInstnId/BICFI to a valid 8 or 11 character BIC.

tags.description: Third intermediary agent. Only valid when IntrmyAgt2 is present.

errors.description: IntrmyAgt3 present without IntrmyAgt2.
possible_fixes: Insert IntrmyAgt2 before IntrmyAgt3, or remove IntrmyAgt3.

tags.description: Previous instructing agent 1, used to trace the agent that previously instructed in the chain. Identified by BICFI.

errors.description: PrvsInstgAgt1 BICFI is invalid.
possible_fixes: Set FinInstnId/BICFI to a valid 8 or 11 character BIC; remove BrnchId (CBPR+ branch removed).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr/MsgId
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest MsgId from GrpHdr and set BizMsgIdr to same value or vice versa.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/Fr/BICFI must equal CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt/BICFI (unless CpyDplct=COPY/CODU)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest InstgAgt BICFI and set AppHdr/Fr to match.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/To/BICFI must equal CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt/BICFI
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest InstdAgt BICFI and set AppHdr/To to match.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal count of CdtTrfTxInf blocks
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Count CdtTrfTxInf elements and update NbOfTxs.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/CtrlSum must equal sum of all IntrBkSttlmAmt
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Sum IntrBkSttlmAmt values and update CtrlSum.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/Prty must equal PmtTpInf/InstrPrty when both present
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Align both to same value; default NORM.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/InstgAgt and CdtTrfTxInf/InstgAgt are mutually exclusive (R5)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove from one level; keep at the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/InstdAgt and CdtTrfTxInf/InstdAgt are mutually exclusive (R4)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove from one level; keep at the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/PmtTpInf and CdtTrfTxInf/PmtTpInf are mutually exclusive (R10)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove from one level; keep at the other.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IntrBkSttlmDt must be at either GrpHdr or CdtTrfTxInf, not both (R8/R9)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Keep at one level only.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: XchgRate required iff InstdAmt.Ccy != IntrBkSttlmAmt.Ccy
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add XchgRate when currencies differ; remove when same.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IntrmyAgt2 requires IntrmyAgt1; IntrmyAgt3 requires IntrmyAgt2
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert missing predecessor agent(s).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If FinInstnId/BICFI present, then Nm and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present in same block
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr when BICFI is present.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If Nm present in FinInstnId, PstlAdr must also be present and vice versa
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add the missing counterpart; or use BICFI.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BrnchId is removed from all agent elements under CBPR+ SR2025
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove all BrnchId elements from agent blocks.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Dbtr/FinInstnId and Cdtr/FinInstnId must use BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification type; PartyIdentification type from pacs.008 is not applicable
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Replace any party-type identification (PrvtId, OrgId AnyBIC under PartyIdentification) with FinInstnId/BICFI or FinInstnId/Nm+PstlAdr.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_COUNTRY_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_CHRGBR_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the W005 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_BIC_DIRECTORY_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Urgent payments should normally be settled on the current date.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_URGENT_DATE_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Conditional Amount Limit based on Purpose Code
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3-PURPOSE-LIMIT constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_IBAN_CURR_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: LEI cannot replace BIC for financial institution agents. CBPR+ requires BICFI.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_LEI_NOT_BIC constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IntrmyAgt2 cannot exist without IntrmyAgt1.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_INTRMY_ORDER_1 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IntrmyAgt3 cannot exist without IntrmyAgt2.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_INTRMY_ORDER_2 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: ISO Purpose Code Validation (SR2025)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_PURPOSE_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: ISO Category Purpose Code Validation (SR2025)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_CTGYPURP_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If Settlement Method is CLRG (Clearing System), Clearing System (ClrSys) identity must be present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_STTLM_CLRG_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Party Identification: Organization ID (/OrgId) and Private ID (/PrvtId) are mutually exclusive. Both cannot be present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_PARTY_EXCLUSIVITY constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Financial Institution Identification: Must contain either a BICFI or a Clearing System Member identification.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_FININSTNID_COMPLETENESS constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Party Identification: When an ID (Organisation /OrgId or Private /PrvtId) is provided, the Name field (/Nm) should also be included for reference.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_NAME_FOR_ID constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Validation of scheme code for Organisation Identification. Allowed: LEI, DUNS, VAT, TXID, GIIN, CRN.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Use a valid Organisation scheme code like 'LEI' or 'DUNS'.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Validation of scheme code for Private Identification. Allowed: CCPT, DRLC, NIDN, SSSN, PASSPORT, NATIONALID.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Use a valid Private scheme code like 'CCPT' (Passport) or 'NIDN'.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Settlement Method must be one of the ISO 20022 standard codes: INDA, INGA, CLRG, COVE
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_SETTLEMENT_METHOD constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Organisation identification cannot accompany personal name and vice versa (ENTITY_MISMATCH).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Ensure the <Nm> tag includes a corporate indicator like 'Ltd', 'Corp', or 'Inc', or use <PrvtId> if this is an individual.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Organisation identification cannot accompany personal name and vice versa (ENTITY_MISMATCH).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove corporate keywords (e.g., 'Ltd', 'Corp') from the <Nm> field, or use <OrgId> if this is a company identification.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Debtor and Creditor are mandatory for all payment messages. For customer credit transfers (pacs.008, pacs.003), Debtor Agent and Creditor Agent are also required.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Ensure <Dbtr> and <Cdtr> blocks are included. For pacs.008/pacs.003, also include <DbtrAgt> and <CdtrAgt>.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr Priority Validation (HIGH, NORM, LOW)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_APPHDR_PRTY_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Service Level Code (SvcLvl/Cd) must be a valid ExternalServiceLevel1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_SVCLVL_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Local Instrument Code (LclInstrm/Cd) must be a valid ExternalLocalInstrument1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_LCLINSTRM_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Clearing System Identification Code (ClrSys/Cd or ClrSysId/Cd) must be a valid ExternalCashClearingSystem1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_CLRSYS_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Cash Account Type Code (Acct/Tp/Cd) must be a valid ExternalCashAccountType1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_ACCT_TYPE_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Entry Status Code (Sts/Cd) must be a valid ExternalEntryStatus1Code.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_ENTRY_STATUS_CODE constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BIC must be exactly 8 or 11 characters (XSD pattern allows it; this gives a clearer error).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: A valid BIC is 8 chars (e.g. NDEAFIHH) or 11 chars including a 3-char branch (e.g. NDEAFIHHXXX).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: LEI must be exactly 20 alphanumeric characters (ISO 17442).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3_LEI_FORMAT constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: JPY amounts cannot have decimal places.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove the decimal portion from the JPY amount (e.g. use '1000' instead of '1000.00').

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: IBAN must contain only uppercase A-Z and digits 0-9.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove any lowercase letters or whitespace from the IBAN value.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Party Name (Nm) should not be a BIC code — likely a mapping error.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Move the BIC value into <BICFI> and put the actual party name in <Nm>.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Settlement / execution dates more than 1 year in the future are unusual.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Verify the date is correct. Future-dated payments beyond 12 months are unusual and may be rejected by clearing systems.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: When IntrmyAgt1 is present, CdtrAgt must also be present. CBPR+ dependency rule: an intermediary agent requires a creditor agent to define the end of the payment chain.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add <CdtrAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>CREDITOR_BIC</BICFI></FinInstnId></CdtrAgt> to the transaction, or remove <IntrmyAgt1> if no intermediary routing is required.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Header Sender BIC (From) must match the Instructing Agent BIC in the Business Message.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3-PACS-MATCH-FR constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Header Receiver BIC (To) must match the Instructed Agent BIC in the Business Message.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the L3-PACS-MATCH-TO constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CBPR+: UETR is mandatory in pacs.009 even though the XSD declares it optional.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add a valid UUID v4 to <PmtId><UETR> (e.g., 4a1a0945-5772-409a-83ba-240e666e0267).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: CBPR+: InstrId, EndToEndId and TxId are mandatory in pacs.009 PmtId (XSD declares some optional).
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add <InstrId>, <EndToEndId> and <TxId> inside <PmtId>.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Financial Institution Credit Transfer: Debtor must identify as a Financial Institution (FinInstnId). customer elements like Nm, OrgId, PrvtId are not allowed.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the PACS009_001 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Financial Institution Credit Transfer: Creditor must identify as a Financial Institution (FinInstnId). customer elements like Nm, OrgId, PrvtId are not allowed.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the PACS009_002 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Financial Institution Credit Transfer: Instructing Agent must be a Financial Institution Identification.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the PACS009_003 constraint and correct the relevant field.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Review the PACS009_004 constraint and correct the relevant field.

schema_mapping_notes.root_element: pacs.009.001.08 root is /Document/FICdtTrf (FinancialInstitutionCreditTransfer, CORE variant); the AppHdr (BAH) precedes the Document.
schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc for CBPR+ FI credit transfer (CORE) is 'swift.cbprplus.03'. The COV variant uses 'swift.cbprplus.cov.03'.
schema_mapping_notes.structure: GrpHdr [1..1] + CdtTrfTxInf [1..n] (single CdtTrfTxInf under CBPR+). Both Dbtr and Cdtr are financial institutions (BICFI). There is no underlying customer transfer in the CORE variant (that is the COV variant).
schema_mapping_notes.amount_location: The settlement amount is IntrBkSttlmAmt directly under CdtTrfTxInf with a Ccy attribute (not wrapped in an Amt container as in pain.001).
schema_mapping_notes.agent_chain: Routing uses InstgAgt/InstdAgt plus the optional IntrmyAgt1..3 and PrvsInstgAgt1..3 chains; each agent is identified by BICFI. Branch identification (BrnchId) was removed under CBPR+.
schema_mapping_notes.fi_parties: Because Dbtr and Cdtr are financial institutions they are identified by FinInstnId/BICFI, never by name+address like a customer.
schema_mapping_notes.datetime_format: ISODateTime fields use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; no 'Z' suffix, no milliseconds.
schema_mapping_notes.nb_of_txs_scope: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the number of CdtTrfTxInf occurrences.
